<?php

/**
 * FIXTURE — not loaded, not scanned, read only by
 * PostWritePinInventoryTest::testADocblockMentionIsNotACallSite().
 *
 * Every "write" below lives in a COMMENT. A guard that matched text
 * rather than tokens would report every one of them, and three separate
 * real incidents on F-361 had exactly that shape:
 *
 *   - substr_count('PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly(') read 3 for 2 calls,
 *     because the comment explaining the guard named it
 *   - the guard flagged function_exists('wp_save_post_revision'), a
 *     defensive check, because the name appeared as a string
 *   - a comment saying "not a PHPStan suppression comment" BECAME one,
 *     because that tool also reads comments
 *
 * So this fixture exists to prove the token walk skips comments, rather
 * than to assert it in a docblock.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

// A plain line comment naming a writer: wp_insert_post([...]);

/* A block comment: wp_update_post(['ID' => 1], true); */

/**
 * A docblock showing the WRONG form, exactly as pinOnly()'s own
 * docblock does:
 *
 *     PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly([], wp_insert_post([...]))
 *
 * and the right one:
 *
 *     PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly([], static fn () => wp_insert_post([...]))
 *
 * plus a model write: new \PeepSoGroup(null, $data)
 * and a dispatch: call_user_func('wp_trash_post', 1)
 * and a revision: wp_save_post_revision(1)
 */
final class CommentOnlyWriteFixture
{
    public function nothingHereWrites(): int
    {
        // wp_trash_post($id);
        // media_handle_sideload($file, 0);
        return 0;
    }
}
